purpose: Improve the three research experiments with validation-driven changes and fresh holdouts

asr.evaluation_exclusion: All speakers used for v1 validation or test
asr.augmentation: Alternating clean and 15 dB Gaussian-noise training recordings
asr.selection: Lowest generated clean validation WER including pretrained baseline; earliest epoch breaks ties

capacity_candidate_added_after_first_dev.reason: Tiny epoch-one development WER 7.74% did not beat the 7.59% pretrained tiny baseline
capacity_candidate_added_after_first_dev.selection: Choose lower generated validation WER between this candidate and selected tiny checkpoint; tiny wins exact ties

speaker.cohort: Two training recordings from each of 48 speakers
speaker.probes: Three recordings from a different chapter of the same speaker
speaker.trials: Every test probe against every enrolled speaker
speaker.selection: Lowest validation FRR at independently calibrated thresholds; then FAR; then listed method order
speaker.uncertainty: Paired probe-speaker bootstrap conditional on the enrolled cohort

intent.test_exclusion: Every v1 recording ID, normalized transcript and source audio checksum
intent.previous_test: Retired as a holdout; eligible for v2 development
intent.epoch_selection: Highest validation macro F1, then lower validation cross-entropy
intent.blend_selection: Highest validation macro F1, then lower validation NLL, then lower audio-text weight
intent.comparison: Evaluate frozen v1 fusion and v2 candidates on the same new test set
intent.uncertainty: Paired language-stratified utterance bootstrap; speaker IDs unavailable

publication: Aggregate results, positional aliases, anonymous speaker groups, error counts and predictions only; no new source transcripts, recording IDs, audio provenance or per-record speaker embeddings
